summary: Frontend-only validation (mobile 390x844 + desktop 1920x800) of MikiLab: PIN lock 1985, NEW OperatoreSelect gate + header chip (Michele / Mohamed Reza), clean plancia (4 nav cards, no Community, no Cyber-Bakery Trio), AuthScreen/ResetPassword security intact, and all operational views (Magazzino, Planner, IoT, Ricette) with no white screen. All targeted flows PASSED.

design_issues.screen: PinLock / ResetPassword / Ricette (headless browser locale en-US)
issues: Copy renders in English ('Enter the security PIN', 'New password', 'MikiLab Recipes') although product spec states Italian UI. Language comes from LanguageContext auto-detect; not a functional bug but verify default fallback should be Italian.

action_items: Optional cleanup: /app/frontend/src/components/CyberBakeryTrio.jsx still exists but is no longer imported anywhere (dead code, cyber-bakery-trio testid never mounts). Safe to delete.
Optional: confirm default UI language should be Italian when browser locale is en-US (PIN screen & reset form rendered in English).
critical_code_review_comments: App.js resetToken flow bypasses both PIN gate and operator gate (locked && !resetToken / !operator && !resetToken). Verified working, but a ?reset=<anything> query param grants full plancia access without PIN — consider rendering ONLY the ResetPassword screen while a reset token is present instead of the full app underneath.

Expected 401s are logged in console for /api/auth/me, /api/favorites/sync and /api/recipes?collection_name=personal while anonymous; they are handled silently but consider skipping these calls when no session exists to avoid console noise.
seed_data_creation: none; only localStorage key mikilab_operator manipulated to re-trigger the operator gate
test_credentials: App PIN 1985 (used, works). No account login attempted per instruction.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified in this run: (1) PIN keypad pin-key-* auto-submits at 4 digits, 1985 unlocks. (2) operatore-select gate appears right after unlock when localStorage 'mikilab_operator' is absent, title 'Chi è in laboratorio?', both cards with working avatars (avatar_miki.jpg / avatar_mohamed.jpg load OK), no operatore-close at the gate; selecting Michele closes gate and loads plancia. (3) operatore-chip shows name on desktop (hidden on <sm by design: class 'hidden sm:inline' so inner_text is empty at 390px — expected, avatar still shown); reopening shows operatore-close + ATTIVO badge on current operator; switching to Mohamed Reza updates chip and localStorage. (4) Lab Control shows exactly lab-nav-ricette/magazzino/planner/iot; lab-nav-community=0 and cyber-bakery-trio=0 in both Lab and Floor. (5) magazzino-manager, SmartPlanner, peripheral-setup+Maestro, Ricette+conferma-impastata all render, no white screen, no error elements. (6) account-btn opens auth-screen, auth-close closes it. (7) ?reset=TOKEN renders the New password form with 2 password inputs and bypasses PIN.
rca_of_the_issue: No defects reproduced; only non-blocking observations (dead CyberBakeryTrio.jsx file, English locale copy, reset-token bypassing PIN gate).
